# Project-local core checks; research execution is explicit.
PYTHON ?= python3
.DEFAULT_GOAL := check
.PHONY: check
check:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py check
export ISSUE_NOTE ISSUE_COMMAND
export DOC TOPIC
.PHONY: latex-ai-validate
latex-ai-validate:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py validate
.PHONY: validate
validate: latex-ai-validate
.PHONY: latex-ai-plan
latex-ai-plan:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py plan
.PHONY: validation-plan
validation-plan: latex-ai-plan
.PHONY: latex-ai-status
latex-ai-status:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py status
.PHONY: status
status: latex-ai-status
.PHONY: latex-ai-doctor
latex-ai-doctor:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py doctor
.PHONY: doctor
doctor: latex-ai-doctor
.PHONY: latex-ai-help
latex-ai-help:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py help
.PHONY: help
help: latex-ai-help
.PHONY: latex-ai-guide
latex-ai-guide:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py guide --topic "$$TOPIC"
.PHONY: guide
guide: latex-ai-guide
.PHONY: latex-ai-guide-html
latex-ai-guide-html:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py guide-html
.PHONY: guide-html
guide-html: latex-ai-guide-html
.PHONY: latex-ai-research-check
latex-ai-research-check:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py research-check
.PHONY: research-check
research-check: latex-ai-research-check
.PHONY: latex-ai-research-validate
latex-ai-research-validate:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py research-check --changed
.PHONY: research-validate
research-validate: latex-ai-research-validate
.PHONY: latex-ai-modules
latex-ai-modules:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py modules
.PHONY: modules
modules: latex-ai-modules
.PHONY: latex-ai-issue
latex-ai-issue:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py issue --note "$$ISSUE_NOTE" --command "$$ISSUE_COMMAND"
.PHONY: issue
issue: latex-ai-issue
